Both reserve an index with a saturating compare/exchange bounded at 0xffff and increment the successful encoder submission counter. Current rejection counter +0x690 is distinct from successful +0x68c.
Both copy eight 16-byte chunks from encoder+0x40 to Frame+itemsBase+index*0x80. Counts checked at encoder+0x84/+0x8c map to item+0x44/+0x4c.
Current Frame itemsBase is +0xb4700 and allocation counter +0xdc57e8; old fields were +0xc0700/+0xdd17e8. Changing the hook address alone would not migrate the reader.

The producer Context/frame reader, backend consumer and native feature-phase/resource ownership remain separate migration/integration requirements. This remains passive observation and does not submit custom geometry.
